Line 1 B Extension Swargate to Katraj Extension

Corridor Details Alignment Corridor Rail Length No. of Stations Underground Elevated Line 1 B Extension Swargate - Katraj 5.46 KM 5 -

This 5.46 KM completely underground Metro line extends the PCMC–Swargate corridor to Katraj. The Swargate to Katraj section will have three stations: Market Yard, Padmavati, and Katraj.
